title: Review Report
description: Step 07 review artifact: weighted scoring normalized across 6 quality dimensions.

verdict.description: Verdict rules: any critical -> REVISE; no critical and major <= 3 -> CONDITIONAL; no critical, no major, weighted >= 4.0 and each dimension >= 3 -> PROCEED.

weighted_score.description: Weighted score = sum(score * weight). Weights: completeness 0.25, consistency 0.20, testability 0.20, user_value 0.15, feasibility 0.10, compliance 0.10.

dimension_scores.description: Exactly 6 dimensions, one score per dimension without omission

score.description: Rating scale: 5 impeccable, 4 minor issues, 3 major issues, 2 systemic defects, 1 unattempted

rationale.description: Must correlate with findings: giving 4 while reporting major issues in the same dimension is contradictory

severity.description: Severity: critical blocks release; major must fix; minor is UX polish; suggestion is optional

location.description: Specific item ID (REQ-xxx, USR-xxx, AC-xxx) or section name, avoiding vague references like 'entire document'

rule_id.description: Violated standard rule ID (e.g. prd.single_responsibility), avoiding subjective impressions

suggestion.description: Exact required modification: what to change and what to change it into
